summary: Specifies the IPv6 Flow Label field and the minimum requirements for nodes that label flows, forward labeled packets, and set up flow state. The label lets devices classify flows using only fixed-position fields in the main header. It replaces RFC 3697 and updates RFC 2205 and RFC 2460.

eli5.summary: Packets of one conversation can wear the same colored sticker. Then a router can group them at a glance, without reading further inside. This sets the rules for the sticker.
